title: reply_result
description: Core's answer to an operator message: accepted (Core took it and passed it on, or will answer), refused (Core did not take it, with an explanation), or failed (only for plugin.call: the Plugin ran and broke, with an explanation; results already sent still stand). Accepted is not done: the Asset's own reports confirm the effect. For plugin.call the reply comes last, so accepted there means the call finished.
